config.hypothesis: Measure the effect of restoring observed-versus-missing split candidates in quantile histograms, with the same cleaned 295 features, Phase 14 parameters, development folds and nested threshold protocol.

missing_values.method: Codebook non-responses become NaN; every tree split evaluates both missing-value directions.

threshold.selection_method: pooled outer OOF F1; exploratory unless nested_threshold_evaluation is present

provenance.elapsed_scope: Current worker invocation; saved tree timings include any completed partial fitting.

memory_estimate.basis: Largest retained float32 cleaned train/validation pair; excludes temporary histogram arrays and runtime overhead.

nested_threshold_evaluation.protocol: Each outer-fold threshold is selected from inner OOF probabilities fitted and preprocessed only on that outer fold's training rows.

outcome.runtime_basis: Current run wall time, including cached metric assembly; excludes earlier interrupted fitting and preparation.
outcome.selection_note: Pooled OOF F1 uses the same labels to select and describe its threshold. Use nested_threshold_evaluation, when configured, for an unbiased threshold result.
